System link: play with the consoles on your network, or over the Internet through XLink Kai. The games find each other as they would on a LAN.
Consoles the network\'s broadcasts don\'t reach (another subnet, a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale), by address.
The address of the computer running the XLink Kai engine on this network (a PC, a Raspberry Pi); its web page picks the game\'s arena.
